rules.entry: close>=0.90*highest(high,252), including current completed bar, AND close>current-inclusive SMA200; full252bar warmup; daily condition, not crossover
rules.informational_5pct: close>=0.95*high252 AND same SMA200; subgroup only, not baseline filter
rules.entry_execution: flat completed-close signal -> next available symbol session open; one long per symbol
rules.trailing_initialization: on entry fill initialize high-water H=entry_price; active stop=0.90*H immediately on entry session
rules.trailing_update: after each completed close while still held, H=max(H,close); next-session stop=.9*H; no high/intraday update and no retroactive current-close stop
rules.execution_priority: at open: if open<=prior active stop, exit at open (trail_gap); else queued prior-close SMA50 exit fills at open; only if still held then low<=active stop fills at stop (trail_touch). One exit max per symbol session. Entry-day stop may close that new trade; no same-session reentry. A close after exit can schedule next-session entry.
rules.SMA_exit: close<current-inclusive SMA50 schedules next-open exit; no same-close execution
rules.chronology_note: Queued SMA market exits must execute at session open BEFORE any later intraday low-stop touch. Choosing intraday touch first then retrospectively filling SMA at open would use future information. Gap-stop and queued SMA coincide as one open fill.
rules.terminal: no forced liquidation; final signals pending; open unrealized returns separate from closed metrics
rules.costs: gross zero brokerage/taxes/slippage/spread; no allocation/capital constraints/portfolioDD
rules.coverage: same692 current exact-universe Turso stocks;52 missing and7 stale excluded; no new Fyers calls or aliases
rules.invalid_price_handling: Two all-zero OHLC candles (BAJAJ-AUTO and NAM-INDIA,18Jun2026) excluded BEFORE indicators and execution. Pending fills use next valid observed session; no zero-price entries or stop fills. Earlier strategies left unchanged; their comparable data-quality limitation should be noted.
limitations: corporate-action adjustment consistency in mixed-source Turso data unverified
daily OHLC cannot establish all intrabar paths; fixed prior-close stop avoids current-close lookahead
zero costs/unconstrained concurrent capital limit implementability

caveats: Historical closed-trade arithmetic statistics, not portfolio returns. Open trades excluded. No equal-capital sizing, compounding, equity curve, CAGR, or portfolio drawdown.
Gross zero costs; present-day universe survivorship bias; mixed-source corporate-action adjustments and missing sessions remain unverified. Extreme returns are data-sensitive, not recommendations.

Two zero-OHLC bars on 18 Jun 2026 (BAJAJ-AUTO and NAM-INDIA) were excluded only in Strategy 7. Earlier six reports remain unchanged. Strategy 3 includes an invalid BAJAJ-AUTO zero-price exit (−100%). Historical comparison is provisional.
Overlap membership uses all entry-condition qualifiers, including already-held stocks; not all fresh orders. No stock qualifies in 4, 5, 6 or 7 strategies.
Year/month statistics group closed trades by exit date; no closed observations means unavailable, not zero. Overlapping trades are not independent.
